name: BioPipelineBench Verified
intro: BioPipelineBench Verified 是 Claude Opus 4.8 System Card 披露的内部生命科学能力评测，覆盖靶向与长读长序列分析、宏基因组组装和染色质分析。更新后的评测仅包含通过外部评审验证的问题；按生命科学评测协议提供 Bash 与包管理器，并且不使用扩展思考。任务来源、数量、切分与详细评分规则未公开。
build_method: 内部问题集，经外部评审验证后形成 Verified 子集；来源、数量与切分未披露
task_type: 生物信息学任务, 科学问答
eval_feature: Bash与包管理器可用, 不使用扩展思考, 外部评审验证问题, 仅披露汇总结果
build_method_en: Internal problem set filtered to an externally reviewed Verified slice; sources, counts, and splits are undisclosed
eval_feature_en: Bash and package managers available, no extended thinking, externally validated problems, aggregate-only reporting
intro_en: BioPipelineBench Verified is an internal life-sciences capability evaluation disclosed in the Claude Opus 4.8 System Card. It covers targeted and long-read sequence analysis, metagenome assembly, and chromatin profiling. The updated evaluation keeps only problems that passed external-reviewer validation and is run with Bash and package managers but without extended thinking; sources, counts, splits, and detailed scoring rules are not public.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW. Reviewed against the Claude Opus 4.8 System Card §8.16 and §8.16.1 (official PDF published 2026-05-28). The diagram is intentionally limited to the disclosed internal evaluation protocol: named workflow families, the updated set containing only problems that passed external-reviewer validation, Bash and package-manager availability for life-sciences tasks except Protocol Troubleshooting, evaluation without extended thinking, and aggregate model percentages. It removes the previously fabricated task-package, dependency-installation, execution-output, and submission-schema chain. Sources, counts, splits, detailed rubrics, and public artifacts remain explicitly undisclosed.
